title: Solid-wood chairs and tables from the maker | Mebli Karpat
description: Solid oak and beech chairs and tables direct from the manufacturer, for restaurants, hotels and furniture retail. Custom sizes and private label.

hero.h1: Solid-wood chairs and tables for hospitality and retail, direct from the manufacturer
